summary: CR-132 Restaurant Settings Wizard Round 3 QA — E2E save bug fix verified PASS. Tested all 9 cases: E2E_SAVE, T6, T8, T2, T10, R1, R2, R3, T14.

ui_bugs.issue: R1 FAIL: Deselecting ALL service channels and clicking Save & Continue advances to Step 4 with no validation error. At least one channel should be required.

R2 FAIL: Enabling GST toggle without entering GST code allows advancing to Step 5 — no validation error shown. GST code input field does not appear after toggling GST ON (data-testid='input-gst-code' or input[name*='gst'] not found).
T14 minor: data-testid='toggle-room-otp' not found but 'Room OTP Required' field IS visible in UI. Testid may be misnamed (perhaps 'toggle-room-otp-required').

test_results.E2E_SAVE: PASS — HTTP 200, no error toast, wizard advanced Step 1 → Step 2
test_results.T6_printer_settings: PASS — All 8 fields present: toggle-print-kot, toggle-billing-auto-bill-print, toggle-printing-in-kds, toggle-print-bill-customer-copy, select-no-of-bill, select-no-of-kot, toggle-use-token, select-kot-language
test_results.T8_channel_tiles: PASS — All 5 channel tiles present: channel-dineIn, channel-takeAway, channel-delivery, channel-room, channel-onlineOrder

test_results.R2_gst_validation: FAIL — No validation error when GST enabled without code; app advances to Step 5
test_results.R3_navigation: PASS — Back button from Step 4 returns to Step 3; full 8-step navigation confirmed (Steps 1→2→3→4→5→6→7→8 with Room ON)
test_results.T14_step8_room_fields: PASS — Step 8 shows Room Billing Included (toggle-room-billing-included), Pay Via Room (toggle-pay-via-room), Room OTP Required (visible but toggle-room-otp testid missing)

action_items: FIX R1: Add validation in Step 3 (Channels & Info) to prevent advancing when zero channels selected — show error 'At least one service channel required'

FIX R2: Add validation in Step 4 (Tax & Charges) — when GST toggle is ON and GST code is empty, block Save & Continue and show 'GST code required'. Also verify GST code input field renders when GST is toggled ON.
FIX T14 minor: Add data-testid='toggle-room-otp' to the Room OTP Required toggle in Step 8 (RestaurantSettingsPage.jsx)
critical_code_review_comments: Step 3: channels validation is missing — no guard in handleSaveAndContinue to check if at least one channel is selected before proceeding
Step 4: GST code validation is missing — when gstEnabled=true, no check for non-empty gstCode before proceeding

success_rate.frontend: 67% (6/9 pass: E2E_SAVE, T6, T8, T2, T10, R3, T14 = 7/9 = 78% if T14 counted as pass)
